label: Selected-world one-way contract: each individual represented as existent in…, from mere possibility
description: Derives the esse contract classically: for an existent x at w, either x is in act of esse, or it is not, in which case it is merely possible (OPEN) and so does not exist at w (OPEN), contradicting its existence. Excluded middle on InAct x esse is used and is listed as a premise.
